welcomeDescription: Your travels and wishlist, saved on your iPhone.
findDescription: Tap a country on the map, or search in Places.
markDescription: Mark places Visited, Wishlist, or Lived.
exploreDescription: Organize trips in Lists. See your progress and country stamps in Stats.
remindersDescription: Get a nudge to mark a new country as visited. You choose what gets marked.
locationDescription: Allow Always access to recognize arrivals in the background.
optional: Entirely optional. You can change reminders in Settings anytime.
remindersOff: Reminders are off. You can turn them on later in Settings.
saveError: Couldn’t save your setup. Try again to continue.
